column3: NASB renders “exhort” as “urge,” “as to appearance” as “face to face,” and “humble” as “meek”; the clause is set off with a dash.
NASB renders “implore” as “ask,” “I reckon” as “I propose,” and “to be daring” as “to be courageous.”
NASB adds “though” and renders “wage war” as “war.”
NASB ends the verse at “fortresses” and moves “overthrowing arguments” into v. 5; “strongholds” is rendered “fortresses.”
NASB begins with “We are destroying speculations,” moved from v. 4, and adds “we are.”
NASB renders “having in readiness” as “we are ready” and “avenge” as “punish.”
NASB follows the critical text without the last “of Christ”; “persuaded” is rendered “confident,” and the first sentence is taken as a statement.
NASB follows the critical text without “and” and “to us”; “be ashamed” is rendered “be put to shame.”
NASB adds “I do not wish” and renders “frighten” as “terrify.”
NASB puts the saying in quotation marks; “weak” is rendered “unimpressive,” and “ignored” is “contemptible.”
NASB renders “dare” as “are … bold” and “classify” as “class.”
NASB follows the critical text; “area” is rendered “sphere,” and “assigned” is “apportioned.”
NASB renders “we came” as “we were the first to come.”
NASB adds “that is” and “men's” and restructures the verse.
NASB adds “the regions” and renders “in the things ready” as “in what has been accomplished.”
